dependencies.label: Full continental and marginal crust inventory
dependencies.acceptance_test: Trace material provenance, crust type/age/thickness, submerged basement and accreted additions for all six; dry-land gain is not crust creation.

dependencies.label: Shared rotations, plate boundaries and deformation
dependencies.acceptance_test: One parent-relative rotation tree per epoch; closed plate circuits, valid full polygons, explicit rifts/sutures/deforming zones and crustal budgets, not six nucleus points.

dependencies.label: Dated elevation, bathymetry and local vertical motion
dependencies.acceptance_test: Terrain and sill uncertainty fields tied to uplift, extension, erosion, deposition and isostasy; authored lines and buffers are initial scenarios only.

dependencies.label: Marine gateways and circulation
dependencies.acceptance_test: Test opening/closing seaways, exchange, currents and coastal productivity under one shared chronology.

dependencies.label: Latitude, seasonal climate and habitable gradients
dependencies.acceptance_test: Preserve polar peripheral refuges and broad habitat requirements without importing Earth climate or assuming identical rainfall.

dependencies.label: Ice storage and feedback
dependencies.acceptance_test: Bound ice volume, loading and plausible timing; native pole frame does not prescribe Earth glacial chronology.

dependencies.label: Shared ocean-volume forcing and local relative sea surface
dependencies.acceptance_test: All gateways use the same dated global forcing plus explicit local responses. Low/high envelope alone does not establish dated openings.

dependencies.label: Drainage, freshwater and food-bearing habitats
dependencies.acceptance_test: Derive catchments and freshwater persistence; test basin capacity, refuge networks and mountain-to-basin drainage.

dependencies.label: Time-dependent access and alternative-path search
dependencies.acceptance_test: Full source-to-destination networks, island landings and hinterlands; adaptive transition sampling and bypass search, not only endpoint masks.

dependencies.label: Era-appropriate water crossings
dependencies.acceptance_test: Currents, drift/return, season, water, craft assumptions and landings; reject a universal distance threshold.

dependencies.label: Founding, restriction and durable contact
dependencies.acceptance_test: Repeated viable founders where required, resource continuity, later limited influx and durable-contact order; graph connectivity does not establish population success.

dependencies.label: Wildlife and freshwater lineage histories
dependencies.acceptance_test: Inventory adopted clade claims and test dispersal/vicariance by guild. Leave unspecified dates open; do not import Earth faunal interchange dates. Review long-lived magical provinces after substrate and habitat relocation without inventing a new catastrophe.

dependencies.label: All-six target fidelity and visible distinction
dependencies.acceptance_test: Compare unlabeled equal-area outlines per continent against old atlas and design targets; assess bodies as well as junctions. IoU is diagnostic, not geological proof.

dependencies.label: Disease reservoirs and contact-network ecology
dependencies.acceptance_test: Check whether altered corridors preserve long-separated disease ecologies and later reciprocal, asynchronous regional disease pressures; no pathogen, one-way plague or uniform susceptibility is invented.

gateways.label: C4 periphery → western C3 → cradle
gateways.positive_test: Complete accessible refuge-to-cradle route predates divergence; multiple habitats and freshwater support settlement
gateways.negative_test: No mandatory ice-interior crossing; new neck must not silently close a climatically essential seaway

gateways.label: Western ↔ eastern mainland cores
gateways.positive_test: Productive core refuges and episodic interior access
gateways.negative_test: Neither absolute isolation nor permanent unrestricted gene flow

gateways.label: Shelf → early specialist island
gateways.positive_test: Island old enough and adequately resourced; era-appropriate rare arrival
gateways.negative_test: Deep separation persists during lowstands; no peninsula joins isolated branch

gateways.label: Shelf → later specialist island
gateways.positive_test: Independent substrate, colonization and differentiation history
gateways.negative_test: No all-land shortcut via a different island or newly attached mainland block

gateways.label: Eastern cradle → shelf-human homeland
gateways.positive_test: Candidate reduces crossing demands with substrate that exists in time; viable founders, water and landings
gateways.negative_test: No dependence on later planned maritime culture; no accidental bridge to specialist islands

gateways.label: Shelf → highland foothills
gateways.positive_test: Relief and foothill resources predate arrival; gradients support differentiation
gateways.negative_test: No permanently sealed foothill/lowland boundary and no flattened highland habitat

gateways.label: Eastern mainland → C1 → C2
gateways.positive_test: Dated exposed approach and internal hinge allow viable dispersal to both interiors
gateways.negative_test: No obligatory open-ocean leg or hinge formed only after occupation

gateways.label: External approach between principal foundings
gateways.positive_test: Repeat opportunities allow small successful contacts and returns
gateways.negative_test: Reject both absolute closure and an unexamined permanent high-throughput bypass

gateways.label: External approach → rim
gateways.positive_test: Separate usable opening first supports durable rim population
gateways.negative_test: No newly mandatory ocean voyage or earlier enduring later-lineage colony invented

gateways.label: Archipelagic recurrent network
gateways.positive_test: Inhabited resourced islands and voyages/returns precede biological differentiation
gateways.negative_test: No continent-wide land shortcut removes the marine selective setting

gateways.label: Rim → watersheds → hinge → spine → basin
gateways.required_mode: Staggered durable contact; maritime bypass and headwater descent
gateways.positive_test: Five viable ecological complexes, watershed coast bypass, hinge-spine relay and spine-basin headwaters
gateways.negative_test: No easier durable-contact route silently reverses order; scouts or trade objects are not durable colonies

gateways.label: C6 and all remote margins/islands
gateways.positive_test: Older biotic and crustal relationships fit the shared global history
gateways.negative_test: No human-route exemption for remote coasts, freshwater lineages or altered ocean gateways

requirements.label: Crust and older biotic provenance
requirements.acceptance_test: All six bodies and added/drowned sectors have provenance; dated wildlife obligations are inventoried.

requirements.label: Ancestral route and shelf macrodivergence
requirements.acceptance_test: Cradle usable before divergence, with exposure/flooding, karst and habitat mosaics rather than a younger replacement.

requirements.label: Island specialist radiation
requirements.acceptance_test: Emergence before occupation, viable founders and persistent marine barriers across relevant lowstands.

requirements.label: Shelf-human founders and branching
requirements.acceptance_test: Earlier HE ancestral branching; multiwave founding in its own window; no assumed chronological order of all individual founder waves.

requirements.label: Highland arrival and differentiation
requirements.acceptance_test: Dated foothill arrival followed by specialist differentiation and recurrent lowland contact.

requirements.label: Early paired-continent founding
requirements.acceptance_test: Selected openings within .65–.45 Ma support multiband founding; southern expansion precedes later principal founding.

requirements.label: Restricted intervening recontacts
requirements.acceptance_test: A sequence of limited bidirectional opportunities preserves independent differentiation; one existential event alone is insufficient.

requirements.label: Refuges and later sister cores
requirements.acceptance_test: Peripheral ancestral refuges stay productive; sister cores can exchange intermittently.

requirements.label: Maritime-before-pelagic sequence
requirements.acceptance_test: Repeatable marine culture predates pelagic differentiation; older rare crossings require no such culture.

requirements.label: Later principal founding
requirements.acceptance_test: A distinct 35–20 ka opportunity supports durable rim settlement by terrestrial/coastal movement.

requirements.label: Five complexes and ordered durable contact
requirements.acceptance_test: Retain viable habitats, coastal bypass, maritime relay, headwater descent and mixed rim successor by 5 ka. Clarify the 8–12 kyr expansion span before enforcing endpoints.

requirements.label: Global ecology and circulation
requirements.acceptance_test: Remote bodies and margins pass the same global environmental and provenance review.

evidence.scope: Current conditional scenario only: polygon validity, selected modern routes, low/high mask gap checks and target overlap. Not dated whole-world terrain.
Authored sill and elevation envelopes satisfy selected inequalities; not independent palaeotopography or a sea-level timetable.
Six limited parcels conserve area at eight sampled epochs in inherited model; not a whole-continent plate circuit.

process_constraints.rule: Dated windows permit events within the window, not continuous access across it. A representative event is only a necessary temporal screen for multigeneration or multiwave processes.
Expansion beyond the rim spans roughly 8–12 millennia; its exact start/end milestones remain unresolved. Do not impose this duration on every durable-contact edge.
Rare bidirectional early-to-late contacts require repeated opportunities, long restricted intervals and viable returns. No numerical migration rate or minimum duration is established.
HE and early island founders may require rare short-water dispersal; do not make them depend on later recurrent planned voyages or magic. No universal safe distance.
One block history and shared sea/ice forcing must support all opening and isolation requirements simultaneously; regional vertical motion remains explicit.

By 5 ka, several connected regional rim successor populations retain ancestry and cultural continuity; the other four complexes remain self-sustaining. Reciprocal, recurrent, asynchronous disease crises drive fragmentation, with ecological and network feedback. Exact pathogen chronology remains open.

Slowly changing magical provinces follow geology, ecosystems and Otherworld relations without fixed ancestry packages. Relocation requires a province review; magic or the Thal catastrophe cannot serve as an unexplained geological or founding-route repair.

retry_policy.condition: A rerun is allowed only after identifying a failed predicate and changing its causal input or using a genuinely different architecture. Unknown evidence is not a failure cured by more retries.
retry_policy.watchdog: Each implementation batch declares expected output, time budget and checkpoint. Review any no-output batch at 60 seconds; terminate or checkpoint if it has no demonstrable progress. Do not restart a deterministic failed call unchanged.
retry_policy.preserve: Keep last reproducible conditional candidate and full failed-candidate record. Do not promote a partially valid map to public canon.
